title: 日本語の森 N1 — 複合助詞と文末表現 (Advanced Compound Particles and Sentence-Ending Expressions)
description: From 日本語の森. This N1 lesson covers complex compound particles (〜にもかかわらず、〜をめぐって、〜に際して) and formal sentence-ending expressions (〜に違いない、〜に他ならない、〜ざるを得ない) found in newspapers, academic writing, and formal speech. Examples drawn from news articles and essays.
